## Problem and change / 问题与改动

Describe the resulting behavior and link related issues.
说明修改后的行为并关联 Issue。

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] `python -m ruff check .`
- [ ] `python scripts/check_repository.py`
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] Regression tests cover changed behavior / 行为变更有回归测试。
- [ ] User-facing documentation is updated in English and Chinese / 同步双语说明。
- [ ] No keys, private captures, generated runs or archives / 不含密钥与私密数据。
- [ ] I have the right to contribute under the project's AGPLv3+ license; third-party sources and notices are included / 有权按项目 AGPLv3+ 许可证贡献，第三方来源与声明齐全。

## Screenshots and compatibility / 截图与兼容性

For UI changes, include only images you may publish. Note breaking changes.
UI 改动仅附有权公开的图片，并说明不兼容变更。
